briefdescription.para: Self-Contained Globally Optimal Sequential Quadratic Programming PnP (SQPnP) Solver.

detaileddescription.para: Implements the SQPnP algorithm from: "A Consistently Fast and Globally Optimal Solution to the Perspective-n-Point Problem" by G. Terzakis and M. Lourakis (ECCV 2020).
